notes.title: VRider SBK is coming soon!
notes.content:
[h2]🏍️Experience the thrill of racing, like never before. 
[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591055/49f694cae0dc5325b9a41ddc62d723c7d04cd6b1.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone!
[/p][p]We are absolutely thrilled for you to meet VRider SBK soon! We are working hard to give you the [b]best experience[/b], hopefully, [b]you will enjoy the ride!
[/b][/p][p]As you might know, VRider SBK is already available on Meta Quest - so you might ask what the difference will be, and whether we have any [b]enhancements[/b] or not. [b]The answer is, we do!
[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Visual improvements[/b] [i](trees, grass, circuits, bikes, buildings, terrain, skids, etc.)[/i] and [b]enhanced graphics[/b] on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Race against Meta Quest players via [b]crossplay![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Animated[/b] crowd & flags.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More AI opponents (22)[/b] in single-player modes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customizable[/b] graphic options.[/p][/*][*][p]and more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for all the support! Make sure to [b]join our Discord and follow our socials[/b] to keep yourself updated at all times.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://twitter.com/VRidergame" style="button"]Twitter[/url] [url="https://discord.gg/S8VjVKzVqs" style="button"]Discord[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/vridergame/" style="button"]Instagram[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@vridergame?_t=8h3VuLD0avJ&_r=1" style="button"]TikTok[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3145740/VRider_SBK/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
